propositions: Project overlay entries keyed by built-in overlay id cannot currently extend built-in overlay triggers; only standalone project.* criteria are supported today
A new project_trigger_extensions helper must read trigger_tokens and applies_to lists from project overlay code_review entries for built-in ids and return them separate from effective_routing

glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays must union project-supplied trigger_tokens (case-sensitive literal substrings on added/removed diff lines) and applies_to globs with committed ones, with repo_root threaded from overlay_union
Project trigger extensions must be ignored (not raised) if malformed: non-list trigger_tokens, non-string tokens, or unknown overlay ids
Behavior with no project overlay must remain byte-identical to current; committed content-trigger regex and glob behavior unchanged for built-in overlays without project extensions
